title: metagonia ovata
intro: Metagonia ovata, commonly known as the "Butterfly Tree," is a flowering plant species that belongs to the family Apocynaceae. It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
